# onetsolutions_hosting_addon_domains (Data Source)

Lists the addon domains of a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_addon_domains" "site" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "addon_domains" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_hosting_addon_domains.site.addon_domains[*].domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting to read from.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `addon_domains` (Attributes List) The addon domains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addon_domains))

<a id="nestedatt--addon_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addon_domains`

Read-Only:

- `document_root` (String) The directory it serves, as an absolute path.
- `domain` (String) The addon domain.
- `subdomain` (String) The internal subdomain of the main domain it is attached to.
